ingredients: 18-24 tortillas (enough for tonight, Tuesday and Wednesday)
To serve: salsa, soured cream, lettuce, avocado
recipe.serves: 4 tonight + 4 for Tuesday + 4 for Wednesday (all fridge)
steps: Fry the onions and peppers in the oil in your largest pan (or two pans) for 8-10 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the beans, sweetcorn and a splash of water. Take out Mathilda's portion now, keeping it plain.
Split what's left into three roughly equal portions: tonight's, Tuesday's and Wednesday's. Stir the fajita seasoning through tonight's portion and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cool the Tuesday and Wednesday portions within an hour, without adding seasoning to them yet.
Cover both extra portions and keep them in the fridge (no need to freeze, they'll be eaten by Wednesday).
Warm tortillas in a dry pan or the microwave. Fill with tonight's filling, cheese and toppings, fold and serve.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: keep hers mild with no seasoning. The extra portions keep in the fridge up to 3 days, so Wednesday's is fine.

ingredients: Monday's fridge portion of fajita filling
To serve: salsa, soured cream, lettuce
steps: Tip the filling into a pan with a splash of water.
Heat gently, stirring, until bubbling and piping hot all the way through (about 8 minutes). Or microwave in a covered bowl for 4-5 minutes, stirring halfway.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or the microwave.
Fill with the filling, cheese and toppings, fold and serve.
recipe.tip: Only reheat it once, and check it's piping hot all the way through. Anyone back late from hockey can have theirs microwaved separately.

ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, skinned and cut into chunks
Small handful fresh parsley or dill, chopped (optional)
steps: Cook the pasta according to the pack instructions. Save a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, soften the leek in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the salmon chunks and cook gently for 4-5 minutes, turning carefully, until just cooked through.
Stir in the peas and crème fraîche and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Take out Mathilda's portion now, keeping it plain.
Toss the pasta through the rest with the lemon zest and herbs, loosening with a splash of the pasta water. Season and serve.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: flake her salmon finely and check carefully for bones. Keep her portion plain without the lemon zest.
